name: OLIFE
fix_description: Same reflect token deliver vulnerability as MCC/HODL. In deliver, reducing _rTotal manipulates the global reflect rate, creating balance/reserve mismatch in LP pair. Fix: exclude LP pair from rate changes or add same-block protection.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit is a multi-step tokenomics-specific attack: flash loan WBNB, buy the reflection token, manipulate reflection accounting via repeated self-transfers plus deliver(), then directly drain the pair using reserve/balance mismatch. It is not deeply complex, but it does require understanding reflection-token internals and AMM reserve math beyond a simple access-control or reentrancy bug.
